question: In the Re: Zero world, do they have the concepts of hours and minutes? If not, do they have something along those lines?
answer: They don’t have hours and minutes, but the basic idea is that they divided up light and dark time periods so that from 6:00 p.m.to 6:00 a.m. is darksun, and from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. is brightsun. I’ve decided that one day is around twenty-four hours, and they have rocks called magic time crystals that change color as time passes, so they look at those and go about their lives at a casual pace.
